production.note: Calendar years. Quote (Koenigsegg): "18 EXAMPLES PRODUCED FROM 2011 TO 2014".

displacementL.note: "5,0L"; no cc figure on Koenigsegg's page.

fuel.note: Runs on 95-octane gasoline or E85 biofuel (flex-fuel).

drivetrain.note: "Power is routed to the rear wheels through a 7-speed dual clutch gearbox."

powerHp.note: Koenigsegg's maximum rating, on E85. Quote (Koenigsegg technical specifications): "Power output: 1140 hp at 7100 rpm – redline @ 7500 rpm"; model page: "1140 BHP Output". GTSpirit road test (gtspirit-agera-r-road-test, Des Sellmeyer, 27 May 2013): "The Koenigsegg Agera R produces 960hp on 95 octane regular fuel and 1,140hp running on E85 bio fuel." At the 2011 launch GTSpirit reported "1,115hp at 6,900rpm" (gtspirit-agera-r-2011); the 1,140 hp rating is the one Koenigsegg publishes now and covers most of the run. Stored as published (powerStandard Other); no kW figure was on the pages opened.

weightLb.note: Koenigsegg curb weight (step 1): 1,435 kg x 2.20462 = 3,164 lb. Quote: "Curb weight: 1435 kg (all fluids plus 50% fuel)"; also "Dry weight: 1330 kg" (GTSpirit 2011: "dry weight of 1,330kg").

discrepancies.reason: Model year: 1,115 hp was the figure reported at the March 2011 launch; Koenigsegg now publishes 1,140 hp (E85) for the Agera R.
discrepancies.resolution: Stored Koenigsegg's current 1,140 hp, which covers most of the 2011-2014 run; reference year 2012.

reviewNotes: Power is Koenigsegg's E85 rating (1,140 hp); on 95-octane gasoline it is 960 hp. A human should confirm the E85 figure is the one to show, consistently with the Jesko. Reference year 2012 assumes the 1,140 hp rating applied from the 2012 cars; the exact changeover year was not found. Whether the Agera R was sold new in the US was not confirmed, so the home market is used.
